title: The Bear Comes Back
offer: Honey is missing again! But this time, the paw prints are BIG. Ask Inga the messenger, she rows past the woods every day.

honey.name: Honey
honey.counted: {count|a pot of honey|{count} pots of honey}

steps.say: A young bear by the woods of Hjortingsala, with a white spot on his chest. The cub you carried, all grown up!

steps.load_say: Then he gets honey of his own, far from my hives. Take him two pots.
steps.say: I put the pots by the old oak. Look! He comes out of the bushes and sniffs. He remembers you!

reward.gift: a bear friend in the woods

fact: Brown bears live alone in the woods, eat berries, roots, fish and, yes, honey.
